question.text: Per the chapter, any change in the valuation methodology or approach for a Cat III AIF shall be construed as:

answer.text: A trivial operational change requiring no disclosure
A material change significantly influencing the investor's decision to remain invested, with SEBI disclosure and reporting compliance required
A routine change requiring only trustee approval
Not disclosable since it is technical

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'Any change in the valuation methodology or approach shall be construed as a material change significantly influencing the decision of the investor to continue to be invested in the AIF scheme. In such circumstances, the AIF must ensure compliance with guidelines issued by SEBI on disclosure and reporting requirements.' The Trap: Trivial/routine/non-disclosable all violate the explicit material-change classification. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C and XIX-D test this. Cross-ref: PMS (XXI-B) treats policy change as material similarly.
